component.name: Universal Media Downloader
component.summary: Download video and audio from thousands of sites

description.p: A lightweight, native GTK4 + libadwaita desktop app for downloading media. Built on yt-dlp, it works with YouTube, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit and thousands of other sites. Supports single videos, playlists, video (MP4, up to 1080p) and audio (MP3).
